assumptions.description: An estimate, with what it rests on
assumptions.label: Estimate, not a measurement: AI-made artifacts times the hours each would take by hand.

codes.ai_made_only: Only artifacts the AI made count: generated, revised by the AI, or built by the prototype builder. Hand-written artifacts, edits and restores save nothing.
codes.baseline_hours: Each AI-made artifact saves its baseline: the hours a person takes to make one by hand, as an admin set them, else the default shown.
codes.review_not_subtracted: The time people spend reviewing and editing an AI draft is not subtracted.
codes.no_hours_for_the_rest: Decisions, validations, assistant conversations and agent runs add no hours.
codes.live_projects: Deleted projects are not counted. Figures are as of the last daily rollup.
